title: rea: the AI agent that reverse engineers apps and binaries

facts.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
facts.setup: npx rea-agents setup (needs Node.js and npm)

facts.native_tools: Hopper, Ghidra, IDA or Kuna, using an installation you already have (README)

scenes.heading: HOW DOES AN APP WORK INSIDE?
scenes.sub: rea · reverse engineering with your coding agent
scenes.say: Ever wondered how an app really works inside? Now you can find out with rea, right from your coding agent.

scenes.heading: rea
scenes.sub: point it at an app or a binary
scenes.say: Point it at an app or a binary, and it digs into how it behaves. Want to build something similar? Start from what the app actually does, not guesses.

scenes.heading: SETUP IN ONE COMMAND
scenes.say: Setup is one command once Node.js is installed: npx rea-agents setup. It connects rea to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents.

scenes.heading: NATIVE BINARIES
scenes.say: For compiled programs, rea works with a disassembler like Hopper or Ghidra.

scenes.heading: THE CATCH
scenes.say: The catch: you need Node.js, and compiled programs need a disassembler installed.
Next time an app does something clever, you'll know how it does it. Which app would you take apart first? Comment REA and I'll pin the link.
